02 / EARN AND GROW

Start from zero.
Grow without deposits.

You do not need to top up a balance to start or keep playing: Mining Blocks does not accept real-money deposits. Earn BLOCKS through in-game activities or exchange mined cryptocurrency for them, then use what you earn to grow your farm.

No depositsBLOCKS from game activitiesGrow with what you earn

Earn — collect BLOCKS

Earn BLOCKS through shortlinks, offerwalls, PTC and Games (beta). Claim an additional bonus from the Faucet every hour.

Tasks — earn rewards for objectives

Complete project tasks to earn XP and BLOCKS: for example, finish shortlinks, craft a miner or open a box.

One action, two benefits: earn in Earn while completing a matching Task.

YOUR NEXT STEPYour first BLOCKS are the start of your farm.

03 / CRAFTING AND BUYING

Craft a miner.
Give it character.

Save BLOCKS, gather materials and choose a recipe. There is no miner merging here: recipes let you craft miners at levels 1–6 directly. Or find the miner you need on the market. Themed series give each collection its own character.

05 / POOLS AND CRYPTO REWARDS

Your power.
A shared result.

Join a pool or create your own. When a pool receives a reward, it is shared among its members according to their contribution.

You can withdraw mined coins or exchange them for BLOCKS to develop your farm.

06 / COLLECTIONS AND CONSISTENCY

Collect more
than miners.

Power Bonus

The project currently has 340 miners. Turning each miner into a card adds between +0.5% and +10% mining power. The more different miners you acquire and convert into cards, the higher your total bonus. New miners join the collection each season.

Start your collection ↗
↗

Loyalty Bonus

Visit the site daily and perform at least one action: each day adds +1% to your Loyalty Bonus. After 100 consecutive days, it reaches 100%. It is added on top of any rewards you receive. Missing a day resets the bonus, and accumulation starts again.

Start building your bonus today ↗
